inputs.name: distribution
inputs.description: Collector build to install: "otelcol-contrib", with the most receivers and exporters, or "otelcol", the smaller core build without journald.

inputs.name: otelcol_version
inputs.description: Collector release to install, without the leading v. Raising it upgrades the collector in place.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of each package, keyed DISTRIBUTION_ARCH.EXT, from the .sha256 file beside it on the release. Change these with otelcol_version.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: The whole collector config as an HCL object, written as YAML, such as { receivers = {...}, exporters = {...}, service = {...} }. Write ${env:NAME} for a value from environment. Replaces the default config. Set this or config_yaml, not both.

inputs.name: config_yaml
inputs.description: The whole collector config as a YAML string, written as it is. Replaces the default config. Set this or config, not both.

inputs.name: otlp_endpoint
inputs.description: Where the default config sends everything over OTLP, such as "https://otlp.example.com" for http or "otel-gateway.internal:4317" for grpc. When null, the default config prints to the debug exporter instead. Not used with config or config_yaml.

inputs.name: otlp_protocol
inputs.description: OTLP protocol for otlp_endpoint: "http" (the otlp_http exporter) or "grpc" (the otlp_grpc exporter).

inputs.name: otlp_headers
inputs.description: Headers the default config sends to otlp_endpoint, such as { Authorization = "Bearer ${env:OTLP_TOKEN}" }. They're in the plan and the config, so put secrets in environment and refer to them.

inputs.name: debug_exporter
inputs.description: Also send everything in the default config to the debug exporter, which writes a line per batch to the collector's journal. Always on when otlp_endpoint is null.

inputs.name: collection_interval
inputs.description: How often the default config's hostmetrics receiver reads the host, as a duration such as "30s".

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: Environment variables for the collector, such as { OTLP_TOKEN = "..." }, for the config to read as ${env:OTLP_TOKEN}. Written to /etc/DISTRIBUTION/conn3x.env, mode 0600; it never reaches state or the plan.
